doc.title: Dave Bennett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 16, 2025

title: Opening and 'Who is Dave Bennett?'
summary: Monk Rowe introduces the archive and asks the DownBeat-inspired question of who Bennett is; he deflects with humor.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive. I am very pleased to have Dave Bennett with me this morning, not exactly musicians’ hours. Hi, Dave.
How are you doing, Monk? Good to see you.

I’m going to — by way of introduction I was talking about how this archive project got started, but Joe Williams the singer helped us get it off the ground way back in 1995. And one of the things I have in the archive is this old DownBeat magazine.
And there’s this article, it says, “Is Joe Williams really Joe Williams?” And somehow I thought of you, because you do so many things in the music world. Who is Dave Bennett? Not getting too deep.
Ah jeez, well I guess I’m still trying to figure that out myself. I’ll let you know when I find out.
